details: Generator-count bound for Yang's canonical ideal.
witness_verification: For #classes/full_cube with n>=4, the established endpoint values or bounds, in parameter order, are $2^n$ and $n$. The first parameter divided by one plus the second tends to infinity. Thus no reverse affine-linear bound holds. See the database-owned endpoint value proofs.
proof: Yang's canonical ideal $I_{\mathcal H}^\star$ has exactly one minimal monomial generator for each $h\in\mathcal H$.  For a nonempty class, the Taylor resolution on these $|\mathcal H|$ generators has length at most $|\mathcal H|-1$, so its projective dimension (Yang dimension) is at most $|\mathcal H|-1$.  The empty class has Yang dimension $0$ by convention.  Thus $\mathrm Y(\mathcal H)\le |\mathcal H|$ in all cases.
name: Size / Yang dimension
